description: Defines Swagger API documentation classes for Floating Rates API in the Fineract project, including request and response schemas for creating, retrieving, and updating floating rate data.

classes.name: FloatingRatesApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: Contains nested classes defining request and response schemas for floating rates API.

classes.name: PostFloatingRatesRequest
classes.description: Schema for creating a new floating rate.

classes.name: PostFloatingRatesRatePeriods
classes.description: Schema for rate periods within a floating rate creation request.

classes.name: PostFloatingRatesResponse
classes.description: Schema for response after creating a floating rate.

classes.name: GetFloatingRatesResponse
classes.description: Schema for retrieving floating rate details.

classes.name: PutFloatingRatesFloatingRateIdResponse
classes.description: Schema for updating a floating rate.

classes.name: PutFloatingRatesChanges
classes.description: Details of changes in update response.
